name: The Everything Factory
desc:
[NEW] Boosts every weekend at 12:00 and 23:00 UTC Sat + Sun!

Build a tycoon from a moving conveyor! Buy rare items off your conveyor belt and upgrade your setup.
Like the game and join the group for +25% mutation luck!

🏭 Drop ores, upgrade, sell
🎰 Grab rare items off your belt
🔨 Use the Auto Build button to build a whole setup!
✨ Roll mutations for stronger items
⭐ Rebirth to keep your best items and upgrade your stats
⏰ Earn cash and gems whilst offline!

Use code 'everythingfactory' for a quick start!
Check the update log in-game for codes!
New code at 25K likes ❤️

💎 Premium users earn +10% bonus gems! 💎

Made by @skizol and @greatkirby22
This game is still early in development. If you encounter bugs or have suggestions please let us know in the group forum!
